policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the qere, which is what MACULA Hebrew projects; the alternative is the ketiv written in the Leningrad Codex.

decisions.evidence: ASV renders 'I and my companions' with no note attached to this unit. The qere וְרֵעותָי is a plural 'my companions', and the ketiv ורעיתי is standardly taken as the same plural written defectively; the English plural therefore excludes neither reading, and nothing in the verse's wording or italics distinguishes them. Base fallback (qere) carries the projection.
